comment: WIDE-VIEW-REPAIR-PLAN §4.1 budgets and the W1 ratchets. Edit `classes`, `hardCapLines`, and each token's `pattern`/`allowedFiles` by hand. Never edit `exceptions`, `load`, `rubricFenceExceptions`, or a token's `files` by hand: run `node scripts/verify-prose-budget.mjs --update` after an intentional shrink. `wordBudgets` (plan §16) is hand-written: one entry per file that cannot meet its class word target without deleting a capability, `{words, reason}`; `--update` lowers `words` and drops a fitted file, never adds one.
